asr: Wilk Zuzanna 412. Mam na liście i mam w głowie.

ref: Pan Edek ręczy, nazwisko się zgadza. Otwieramy.
asr: Pan Edek ręczy. Nazwisko się zgadza. Otwieramy.

ref: Jutro mam egzamin z zamków historycznych. To się liczy jako praktyka?
asr: Jutro mam egzamin z zamków historycznych. To się liczy jako praktyka?

ref: Siedemdziesiąt lat ją trzymam. Klucz był jeden. Wnuk go zgubił.
asr: 70 lat ją trzymam. Klucz był jeden. Wnóg go zgubił.

ref: A pan wie, jak ją otworzyć?
asr: A Pan wie jak ją otworzyć?

ref: Wiem. Ale chcę zobaczyć, czy młodzi jeszcze umieją.
asr: Wiem, ale chcę zobaczyć czy młodzi jeszcze umieją.

ref: To pismo w zeszycie znam. Henryk. Uczyłem go. Dobrze trafił ten zeszyt.
asr: To pismo w zeszycie znam. Henryk, uczyłem go. Dobrze trafił ten zeszyt.

ref: Wiem, że kodem była jakaś data. Tylko czyja?
asr: Wiem, że kodem była jakaś data, tylko czyja.

ref: Szkoła się zgadza. Proszę otwierać, przy wszystkich.
asr: Szkoła się zgadza. Proszę otwierać. Przy wszystkich.

ref: Pani Jadwigo, my mieliśmy wtedy dziewięć lat. Pamiętam tylko kasztany.
asr: Panie Jadwigo, my mieliśmy wtedy 9 lat. Pamiętam tylko kasztany.

ref: Mój list: „Mam nadzieję, że masz psa”. Mam kota. Też się liczy.
asr: Mój list. Mam nadzieję, że masz psa. Mam kota. Też się liczy.

ref: Pan otworzy, ja popatrzę i powiem reszcie. Przecież się podzielimy.
asr: Pan otworzy, ja popatrzę i powiem reszcie. Przecież się podzielimy.

ref: Otworzę, gdy będą wszyscy spadkobiercy albo ich zgoda na piśmie.
asr: Otworzę, gdy będą wszyscy spadkobiercy, albo ich zgoda na piśmie.

ref: Ewa będzie za godzinę. Marek, nastaw wodę.
asr: Ewa będzie za godzina. Marek, nastaw wodę.

ref: Wujek by się śmiał, że się kłócimy o pudło z tarczą.
asr: Wujek by się śmiał, że się kłócimy o pudło starczą.

ref: Pani Zosia mówiła, że pan nie wierci. Mąż nie znosił wiercenia.
asr: Pani Zosia mówiła, że Pan nie wierci. Mąż nie znosi uwiercenia.

ref: Otworzę tak, że nikt nie pozna. Mebel zostanie jego.
asr: Otworzę tak, że nikt nie pozna. Mebel zostanie jego.

ref: Bilety do opery. Osiemdziesiąty siódmy.
asr: Bilety do opery. 87.

ref: Mówił, że je zgubił. Trzymał je.
asr: Mówił, że je zgubił, trzymał je.

ref: Klucz nie wchodzi. Zamek się zepsuł, jak mnie nie było.
asr: Klucz nie wchodzi. Zamek się zepsuł, jak mnie nie było.

ref: Panie Kazimierzu, na skrzynce jest inne nazwisko. I ten wieniec?
asr: Panie Kazimierzu, na skrzynce jest inne nazwisko. I ten wieniec?

ref: Kto tam? Mieszkam tu dwanaście lat. Wieniec sama wiłam.
asr: Kto tam? Mieszkam tu 12 lat. Wieniec sama, Wiłam.

ref: O, piętro wyżej klucz wchodzi. Naprawił pan.
asr: O, piętro wyżej klucz wchodzi. Naprawił pan.

ref: Mamy zgodę na kopie. Szuflada uważa je za oryginały.
asr: Nam jest gode na kopie. Shuflada uważa je za oryginały.

ref: Podpis jest mój. Oryginały zostają w muzeum.
asr: Podpis jest mój. Orginały zostają w muzeum.

ref: Kuratorka, protokół, ustalona cena. Otwieramy tylko szufladę.
asr: Kura torka, protokół, ustalona cena. Otwieramy tylko szufladę.

ref: Na wystawie dam napis „Obchodzić się ostrożnie”. Zacznę od tej szuflady.
asr: Na wystawie dam napis, obchodzić się ostrożnie. Zacznę od tej szuflady.

ref: The plot's in my wife's name. I do the digging. She's home resting her knee.
asr: The plot's in my wife's name. I do the digging. She's home resting her knee.

ref: Got your allotment card? And a neighbour to vouch for you?
asr: Got your allotment card? And a neighbour to vouch for you?

ref: Zbyszek's been here longer than that shed. Longer than me.
asr: Ha, Zbyshek's been here longer than that shed. Longer than me!

ref: How about cucumbers? I never bring cash to the allotment.
asr: How about cucumbers? I never bring cash to the allotment.

ref: I changed it to a safer code. So safe that even I don't know it.
asr: I changed it to a safer code. So safe that even I don't know it.

ref: The bike's on the street. Anything to show it's yours?
asr: The bike's on the street. Anything to show it's yours?

ref: A holiday photo and the receipt in my email. The bike looks better than I do.
asr: A holiday photo and the receipt in my email. The bike looks better than I do.

ref: That'll do. Fix your tie while I work.
asr: That'll do. Fix your tie while I work.

ref: Auction invoice, listing and photos. The lock stays untouched.
asr: Auction invoice, listing and photos. The lock stays untouched.

ref: A lock like this was displayed in a London shop window. They offered a reward.
asr: A lock like this was displayed in a London shop window. They offered a reward.

ref: Did anyone open it?
asr: Did anyone open it?

ref: Someone did, more than sixty years later. I'll tell you who when I'm done.
asr: Someone did. More than 60 years later. I'll tell you who when I'm done.

ref: I'm on the balcony like Juliet. Except Romeo is sixty and has the gate key.
asr: I'm on the balcony like Juliet, except Romeo is 60 and has the gate key.

ref: Madame Magda has lived here forever. Depuis toujours.
asr: Madame Magda has lived here forever, depuis toujours.

ref: Lease, address from the commune, and a neighbour. That's enough. Please don't lean over the railing.
asr: Lease, address from the commune and a neighbour. That's enough. Please don't lean over the railing.

ref: Geraniums watered. Mission accomplished.
asr: Geraniums Watered Mission Accomplished

ref: He did it on purpose. He looked me in the eye when he jumped on the handle.
asr: He did it on purpose! He looked me in the eye when he jumped on the handle.

ref: It's your home. He's in the bathroom. No paperwork needed this time.
asr: It's your home. He's in the bathroom. No paperwork needed this time.

ref: What if he gets scared?
asr: What if he gets scared?

ref: Keep talking to him. I'll be quieter than he is.
asr: Keep talking to him. I'll be quieter than he is.

ref: I'm calling for advice, not to book a job. Mrs Martine has Grandpa's box.
asr: I'm calling for advice, not to book a job. Mrs. Martine has grandpa's box.

ref: C'est à votre famille. I only looked after it.
asr: It's your family. I only looked after it.

ref: You looked after it for seventy years?
asr: You looked after it for 70 years?

ref: You both agree to open it. Easiest permission check of my career.
asr: you both agree to open it. Easiest permission check of my career.

ref: The rota is ready. Only the cabinet refuses to display it.
asr: The rotor is ready. Only the cabinet refuses to display it.

ref: I manage this building. Here's the residents' signed decision.
asr: I managed this building. Here's the resident's signed decision.

ref: Permission and price are settled. I'll open the shared cabinet.
asr: Permission and price are settled. I'll open the shared cabinet.

ref: First notice: the cleaning rota. A bold opening.
asr: First notice, the cleaning rotor. A bold opening.

ref: Lala's been stuck in there since Tuesday. She's bored.
asr: Lala's been stuck in there since Tuesday. She's bored.

ref: Grandpa called it an Egyptian lock. I'm not sure how true that is.
asr: Grandpa called it an Egyptian lock. I'm not sure how true that is.

ref: The name stuck. The real story's better. I'll tell you when we're done.
asr: The name stuck. The real story is better. I'll tell you when we're done.

ref: Will you make a new key? A wooden one? Dad has a plank.
asr: Will you make a new key? A wooden one? Dad has a plank!

ref: I could play with spoons, but I'd rather not. Gig's in an hour.
asr: I could play with spoons, but I'd rather not. Gig's in an hour.

ref: Iga rents locker eight. Pays every month. It's all in my notebook.
asr: Eager Rentz Locker 8. Pays every month. It's all in my notebook.

ref: Your notebook will do. Mr Edek said you write everything down.
asr: Your notebook will do. Mr. Eddick said you write everything down.

ref: If you make it in time, we'll play one for you. Loudly.
asr: If you make it in time, we'll play one for you. Loudly.

ref: The store is on my list. It belonged to the old theatre.
asr: The store is on my list. It belonged to the old theatre.

ref: We're borrowing chairs. No one ordered drums this time.
asr: We're borrowing chairs. No one ordered drums this time.

ref: Your register and the university letter agree. So does the fee.
asr: Your register and the university letter agree. So does the fee.

ref: Good. Let's hope the chairs keep better time than the band.
asr: Good. Let's hope the chairs keep better time than the band.

ref: In Finland everyone has a padlock like this. Nobody opens it without the key.
asr: In Finland, everyone has a padlock like this. Nobody opens it without the key.

ref: The chest is Aino's, I vouch for her. We sail at six tomorrow.
asr: The chest is I knows, I vouch for her. We sail at six tomorrow.

ref: The captain vouches for her, and her seafarer's book matches. Let's have a look.
asr: The captain vouches for her and her seafarers book matches. Let's have a look.

ref: If you open it, I'll tell you where this invention came from.
asr: If you open it, I'll tell you where this invention came from.

ref: My Polish stretches to "dzień dobry" and "pierogi".
asr: My Polish stretches to dzień dobry and pierogi.

ref: That's half the language.
asr: That's half the language.

ref: A letter from the parish council. The key went to heaven with my predecessor.
asr: A letter from the parish council. The key went to heaven with my predecessor.

ref: No marks, I promise. This lock is older than my building.
asr: No marks, I promise. This lock is older than my building.

ref: I bought the whole bench. The drawer doesn't recognise the invoice.
asr: I bought the whole bench. The drawer doesn't recognise the invoice.

ref: Invoice, collection photo, agreed price. All accounted for.
asr: Invoice, collection photo, agreed price, all accounted for.

ref: Please leave no marks. The bench is going to the common room.
asr: Please leave no marks. The bench is going to the common room.

ref: Agreed. For once, the paperwork arrived before me.
asr: Agreed. For once, the paperwork arrived before me.

ref: I only stepped out for a moment, dear. With the rubbish.
asr: I only stepped out for a moment, dear, with the rubbish.

ref: I shut off the gas on the landing. We've lived next door for forty years.
asr: I shut off the gas on the landing. We've lived next door for 40 years.

ref: That helps. And the letter in the mailbox is addressed to you?
asr: That helps. And the letter in the mailbox is addressed to you?

ref: I made the noodles myself. There's a bowl for you, no arguing.
asr: I made the noodles myself. There's a bowl for you, no arguing.

ref: Dad never said what he kept in there. Not even to us.
asr: Dad never said what he kept in there, not even to us.

ref: Mum, he's not asking about the chest. He's asking if the house is yours.
asr: Mum, he's not asking about the chest. He's asking if the house is yours.

ref: It's mine. The deed is in the dresser, under the tablecloth.
asr: It's mine. The deed is in the dresser under the tablecloth.

ref: Letters. From Charleroi. To Grandma, in Polish, with Belgian stamps.
asr: Letters from Charlevoix to Grandma in Polish with Belgian stamps.

ref: My dumpling recipe is inside. All I recall is the word 'handful'.
asr: My dumpling recipe is inside. All I recall is the word handful.

ref: It's Halina's box. See? It's beside her mug in this photo.
asr: It's Helena's box. See? It's beside her mug in this photo.

ref: Photo, witness, agreed price. We can begin.
asr: Photo, witness, agreed price, we can begin.

ref: Afterwards we'll settle how much a handful weighs. It's an old dispute.
asr: Afterwards we'll settle how much a handful weighs. It's an old dispute.

ref: That padlock's been here thirty-two years. Never oiled it once.
asr: That padlock's been here 32 years, never oiled it once.

ref: Mrs Krysia vouches for you, and the wholesaler's letter is here. Just one more thing.
asr: Mrs. Krisha vouchers for you, and the wholesaler's letter is here. Just one more thing.

ref: From opening day in '94. My moustache looked better than the kiosk.
asr: From opening day in 94 my mustache looked better than the kiosk

ref: Stefan's been here longer than the bus stop. Even the buses know him.
asr: Stefan's been here longer than the bus stop. Even the buses know him.

ref: The safe is mine. I rent the shop from the city. The café owner next door can confirm.
asr: The safe is mine. I rent the shop from the city. The cafe owner next door can confirm.

ref: And while you're at it, this little box. A customer left it for valuation.
asr: And while you're at it, this little box, a customer left it for valuation.

ref: The safe, yes. The box, no. I'll need its owner here.
asr: The safe, yes. The box, no. I'll need its owner here.

ref: You're right. I'm getting old. And impatient.
asr: You're right. I'm getting old. And impatient.

ref: The heritage officer said not a single hole. Not one.
asr: The Heritage Officer said not a single hole, not one.

ref: Quite right. Somebody worked hard on this a hundred and thirty years ago.
asr: Quite right. Somebody worked hard on this 130 years ago.

ref: Hello again. I'm an intern here now. I passed the exam. Room 412 helped.
asr: Hello again, I'm an intern here now. I passed the exam. Room 412 helped.

ref: The building owners passed a resolution. Here's the work order in writing.
asr: The building owners passed a resolution. Here's the work order in writing.

ref: Józef made this photo box. I think the little key was wooden.
asr: Youssef made this photo box. I think the little key was wooden.

ref: We have a photo of him holding it. And the box is at Mum's.
asr: We have a photo of him holding it, and the box is at mum's.

ref: The photo and your daughter's word are enough. I'll write down the fee.
asr: The photo and your daughter's word are enough. I'll write down the fee.

ref: Fine. Just don't ask what we used to wear.
asr: Fine. Just don't ask what we used to wear.

ref: My uncle had thirty keys and labelled none of them.
asr: My uncle had 30 keys and labelled none of them.

ref: The lock felt the wrong key and took offence. Can't fault it for that.
asr: The lock felt the wrong key and took offence. Can't fault it for that.

ref: Handover papers and the lease. The dough rises without permission.
asr: Hand over papers in the lease. The dough rises without permission.

ref: The papers check out. I'll hold you to those six o'clock waffles.
asr: The papers check out. I'll hold you to those six o'clock waffles.

ref: The posters are inside. Potato is guarding them from the wrong side.
asr: The posters are inside. Potato is guarding them from the wrong side.
